f8af1cbe3586c7d5.en: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
f8af1cbe3586c7d5.zh: 信息请求按特别规则审查。信息不涉及接收方活动时，应适用转交有权机关并通知使用者的规则。

ff9ce86bb629cef0.en: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
ff9ce86bb629cef0.zh: 对已公开信息，可以在答复中指出出版物或信息所在官方网站地址。应核查所请求信息确实发布于该官方网站。直接链接更方便使用者，但并非法律唯一允许的格式。

4682d6b59aa44cf1.en: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
4682d6b59aa44cf1.zh: 机关指定负责信息获取的部门或官员。部委网站发布某法律，并不意味着该部委掌握所有被请求的地方文件。

94c06eeefc045872.zh: 第8-ФЗ号法律 · 信息获取

044ee817d9aa76f7.en: Contact centre for incoming correspondence and general enquiries: 8 (499) 254-50-72. This is an enquiry line, not submission of a written appeal.
044ee817d9aa76f7.zh: 来文及一般咨询联络中心：8 (499) 254-50-72。这是咨询联系渠道，不是书面申诉提交渠道。

408259c014359050.en: Rosprirodnadzor Interregional Administration for Moscow City and Kaluga Oblast. Moscow reception: 8 (495) 025-23-82, extension 77904. The territory named matters: Moscow City and Moscow Oblast are not interchangeable.
408259c014359050.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局莫斯科市及卡卢加州跨地区管理局。莫斯科接待电话：8 (495) 025-23-82，分机77904。名称中的辖区很重要：莫斯科市与莫斯科州不能互换。

51b53cdb0379128a.en: Federal Service for Supervision of Natural Resources

cabdc94d252213eb.zh: 中央机关；另有地域机构

6f94e73249f37d64.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局 · 联系方式

13738b51a4ea4d21.en: The council's page lists 8 (495) 777-31-52, extensions 3934 or 3924. An official website does not make this number suitable for every appeal.
13738b51a4ea4d21.zh: 委员会页面公布电话8 (495) 777-31-52，分机3934或3924。网站是官方的，并不意味着该号码适用于所有申诉。

41414d46391c28b3.en: This contact is only for the Scientific and Technical Council's own activities. Find other contacts in the agency's appropriate section.
41414d46391c28b3.zh: 该联系方式仅处理科学技术委员会自身活动事项。其他联系方式应在机关相应栏目查找。

34f3e1b60740abfa.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局科学技术委员会

44c4dcbfa891f401.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局 · 科学技术委员会

d45e824aaac52bb3.en: The regulation describes the territorial body for Moscow and Smolensk Oblasts. The shared word 'Moscow' does not establish jurisdiction over a facility in Moscow City.
d45e824aaac52bb3.zh: 章程描述的是莫斯科州及斯摩棱斯克州地域机构。名称同有“莫斯科”，不能证明其对莫斯科市设施有管辖权。

b8bd09fd9f14741b.en: Rosprirodnadzor Interregional Administration for Moscow and Smolensk Oblasts
b8bd09fd9f14741b.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局莫斯科州及斯摩棱斯克州跨地区管理局

799f3b6273f9b925.zh: 莫斯科州与斯摩棱斯克州

e92bbdd53ee670e0.zh: 俄罗斯自然资源监督局 · 另一地域管理局

3456ca1a7de6b964.en: Compare a new document or photograph with the subject and date of the old reply. The same letter writer does not prove the issues are identical.
3456ca1a7de6b964.zh: 应将新文件或照片与旧答复的事项和日期比较。同一人来信，并不能证明问题相同。

acdfa7c2cf97f4f0.en: In the original manhole stories, the network owner is unknown; in the river stories, one photograph establishes neither pollution composition nor the supervision level. Assumptions cannot replace missing facts.
acdfa7c2cf97f4f0.zh: 原始检查井故事中，管网所有人尚不明确；河流故事中，一张照片既不能确定污染成分，也不能确定监督层级。假设不能替代缺失事实。

da2d628d5fc9e4db.en: Fictional official materials of the simulator

9b3075af8b6be54d.en: Case materials · register and contractor's reply
9b3075af8b6be54d.zh: 案卷材料 · 登记册与承办方答复

9fab86cff7a3d0b6.en: Where information has public and restricted parts, provide the public information. Justify restriction of the remainder by the relevant act.
9fab86cff7a3d0b6.zh: 信息同时包含公开和限制部分时，应提供公开信息。其余部分的限制须以相应法律文件说明依据。

c559ab94ba211b7a.en: Applicability to a particular story depends on its circumstances. A document title alone does not justify the selected action.
c559ab94ba211b7a.zh: 是否适用于具体故事取决于案情。仅有文件标题不能证明所选行动有依据。

facabd3e8d7a8b29.en: Author's training summary of the verified provision, not a website copy
facabd3e8d7a8b29.zh: 经核查规定的作者教学概述，并非网站复制件

1e909c7a0fac12fa.zh: 第8-ФЗ号法律 · 信息的不同部分

842044eba2f13c2f.en: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
842044eba2f13c2f.zh: 其他申请人、设施或期间的信息，不能替代本案核查。机关名称不赋予工作人员无限职权。

b3d8661c2502a334.en: The city service's letter and diagram concern manhole К-17. Its inspection report confirms an open access opening. The internal diagram identifies the duty service as the recipient of an operational report.
b3d8661c2502a334.zh: 城市服务部门信函及示意图对应检查井К-17。该对象检查报告确认井口敞开。内部图示指定值班部门为应急通报接收方。

746a398683a49947.en: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
746a398683a49947.zh: 教学材料；链接指向法律依据

b255690bf5d10e55.en: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
b255690bf5d10e55.zh: 第一段复述题目条件，并非真实规程或网站摘录。外部链接用于核查法律依据，而非事件事实。

cda4bdeaa529c898.en: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
cda4bdeaa529c898.zh: 仅限本虚构情景的事实

f9c223248edc0c1c.en: The network owner is now known · checking the basis
f9c223248edc0c1c.zh: 现在已知管网归谁 · 依据核查

0868bc7704ad92ae.en: The original photograph still shows no cover. The later report and photograph match the place and number and confirm completed repairs. The old photograph does not invalidate the verification result.
0868bc7704ad92ae.zh: 原始照片中尚无井盖。较晚报告与照片的地点、编号一致，确认维修完成。旧照片的存在不否定核查结果。

7720849d70e12730.en: The photograph predates the repair · checking the basis
7720849d70e12730.zh: 照片拍于维修之前 · 依据核查

eaaabf28048f7ac9.en: The surname-change certificate is dated later than the service result. The original information matched. This timeline distinguishes changed data from an error, but does not remove the duty to consider a complaint about refusal to correct an alleged typo.
eaaabf28048f7ac9.zh: 改姓证明日期晚于服务结果。原始信息当时一致。这一时间线区分了信息变化与错误，但不免除对拒绝更正疑似笔误投诉的审查义务。

29ebe4d595824706.en: The data changed after issuance · checking the basis
29ebe4d595824706.zh: 信息在签发后才变化 · 依据核查

eaa799d33a779a9a.en: Article 11.2, part 6 covers not only refusal to correct errors but complaints about breach of the prescribed correction period. That period is confirmed and has expired in this case; no new negative act needs to be awaited.
eaa799d33a779a9a.zh: 第11.2条第6款不仅涵盖拒绝更正错误，也涵盖违反规定更正期限的投诉。本案期限已确认且已届满，无须等待新的否定文件。

36855d88a037bbe8.en: Correction was promised; the deadline passed · checking the basis
36855d88a037bbe8.zh: 更正承诺已有，期限已过 · 依据核查

b6ceb73af926e105.en: The service conditions allow a document or another prescribed identification method. The exception for identity documents does not require acceptance of an arbitrary photograph. The requirement is not extended to unnecessary copies.
b6ceb73af926e105.zh: 服务条件允许证件或其他规定的身份核验方式。身份证件例外不意味着必须接受任意照片，也不应扩大为多余复印件要求。

a44c67d4391467da.en: Passport photograph and identification method · checking the basis
a44c67d4391467da.zh: 护照照片与身份核验方式 · 依据核查

5f3beb55f8fcd133.en: The act cites only the lack of a reply providing interagency information. Article 7.1, part 6 does not permit this as grounds to refuse the applicant. Applicability is limited to the specified information category.
5f3beb55f8fcd133.zh: 文件仅指出跨部门信息请求未获回复。第7.1条第6款不允许以此为由拒绝申请人。适用范围限于所指信息类别。

100ac8e01a0604b7.en: Another agency did not reply · checking the basis
100ac8e01a0604b7.zh: 另一机关未回复 · 依据核查

9f1179e4373499a1.en: The register records completion by the service-providing body and receipt of the result by the service centre. What remains is delivery and proper notification, not initial consideration.
9f1179e4373499a1.zh: 登记簿记载办理机关已完成服务，公共服务中心已收到结果。剩余的是交付和适当通知，而非首次审查。

ecc19f93b2433130.en: The completed result is at the centre · checking the basis
ecc19f93b2433130.zh: 办好的结果留在中心 · 依据核查

cac21c5cc549ea6a.en: The available package confirms no rule changes, new errors, expired period or properly documented exception for an erroneous action. Article 7, part 1, clause 4 requires these circumstances to be checked, not automatic acceptance of yet another list.
cac21c5cc549ea6a.zh: 现有材料未确认规则变更、新错误、期限届满，或针对错误行为的合规例外文件。第7条第1款第4项要求核查这些情形，而非自动接受又一份清单。

b21299c51e45f097.en: A new document is missing every time · checking the basis
b21299c51e45f097.zh: 每次都缺新文件 · 依据核查

3329cfdd729d71d8.en: The training regulations identify receipt of a complete application as the triggering event. Booking an appointment is not submission. A complaint about alleged delay follows its own procedure independently of checking the service period.
3329cfdd729d71d8.zh: 教学规程将收到完整申请规定为起算事件。提前预约不等于提交申请。对疑似逾期的投诉按自身程序审查，与服务期限核查相独立。

25d98850acff62fa.en: They counted from appointment booking · checking the basis
25d98850acff62fa.zh: 从预约开始计算期限 · 依据核查

a5c85c4a495279f6.en: The receipt confirms acceptance. The disputed act was issued by the service-providing body; it refuses the service, not acceptance of documents. Under the general procedure, this subject has a fifteen-working-day complaint consideration period.
a5c85c4a495279f6.zh: 收据确认已经受理。争议文件由服务提供机关签发，拒绝的是提供服务，而非受理文件。一般程序下，该事项的投诉审查期限为十五个工作日。

fccc5c31845a7d4c.en: Documents accepted, service not granted · checking the basis
fccc5c31845a7d4c.zh: 文件已收，服务未批 · 依据核查

bf040cf72892af1f.en: The training extract names a specific service and participating centre. Acceptance regardless of residence is confirmed for that service. These conditions are not a universal list for all centres' services.
bf040cf72892af1f.zh: 教学摘录列明具体服务及参与中心。已确认该服务不受居住地限制即可受理。这些条件并非所有中心服务的通用清单。

9a59f79c5f8b0f0d.en: Registered in another district · checking the basis
9a59f79c5f8b0f0d.zh: 户籍在另一个区 · 依据核查

96726fce68b5e8da.en: The issuing body signed the refusal. The service centre is confirmed to have accepted and forwarded the application. Correcting the act and reviewing a complaint against its author do not pass to the centre merely because it handed over the document.
96726fce68b5e8da.zh: 拒绝文件由结果签发机关签署。已确认公共服务中心受理并转送了申请。不能仅因文件在中心交付，就将文件更正和对签发者投诉的审查权转给中心。

1f86fdc42a8360a5.en: Typo in another body's act · checking the basis
1f86fdc42a8360a5.zh: 另一机关文件中的笔误 · 依据核查

3b88c9f8e2e3dc4f.en: Article 7 of Law No. 210-ФЗ distinguishes requiring interagency information from the option to supply it voluntarily. The case conditions confirm that the voluntarily supplied document is permissible and in proper form.
3b88c9f8e2e3dc4f.zh: 第210-ФЗ号法律第7条区分要求跨部门信息与允许申请人主动提供信息。本案条件确认自愿提交的文件被允许且形式合规。

1f87652fe88601e5.en: The applicant brought the information voluntarily · checking the basis
1f87652fe88601e5.zh: 申请人主动提供信息 · 依据核查

79f9273833ba688d.en: A reply to a data subject excludes other subjects' data unless disclosure has a lawful basis. Individual access does not mean access to the entire dataset.
79f9273833ba688d.zh: 向数据主体答复时，除有合法披露依据外，不应包含其他主体的数据。个人查阅权不等于访问整个数据集。

c8ca792e0a758807.zh: 第152-ФЗ号法律 · 他人信息

afa61cbdfb237477.en: In a separate consent, the subject identifies the personal data by category. Assessing dissemination requires checking the specifically authorised contents.
afa61cbdfb237477.zh: 数据主体在单独同意书中按类别确定个人数据清单。评价传播时，必须核查具体获准内容。

1a516dbf9144735f.zh: 第152-ФЗ号法律 · 同意范围

b04638f3fe72f67b.en: Personal data concern a directly or indirectly identifiable individual. A table's title and removal of a surname do not, by themselves, resolve identifiability.
b04638f3fe72f67b.zh: 个人数据的标准是与可直接或间接识别的自然人有关。表格名称和删除姓氏，本身不能解决是否可识别的问题。

abcd0f0bcfe2685e.zh: 第152-ФЗ号法律 · 个人可识别性

c45de2e6735e6857.en: Consent names a first name and photograph. The public post also contains health restrictions. A separate form does not extend consent to every data category.
c45de2e6735e6857.zh: 同意书列明姓名和照片。公开内容却增加了健康限制信息。拥有单独表格，并不使同意范围扩大到所有数据类别。

d9abde6819978fb1.en: Consent covered a photograph · checking the basis
d9abde6819978fb1.zh: 同意的只是照片 · 依据核查

37fe5189a1951291.en: At the verified stage, the table is not visible to an indefinite public; named recipients have access. The law distinguishes disclosure to an indefinite public from provision to a specific person or defined group.
37fe5189a1951291.zh: 在已核查阶段，不特定公众无法查看表格，只有指定接收方可访问。法律区分向不特定公众公开，与向特定个人或明确范围的群体提供。

538cf440674030a0.en: The table appeared in my account · checking the basis
538cf440674030a0.zh: 表格出现在我的账户里 · 依据核查

89b3dcb855cacf93.en: The request concerns dissemination of a name and photograph in a public album. It does not automatically cover internal records that may be processed on another lawful basis.
89b3dcb855cacf93.zh: 请求涉及公开相册中的姓名和照片传播，不自动涵盖可能依据其他合法理由处理的内部记录。

9b7d2788602b56b8.en: Permission is no longer valid · checking the basis
9b7d2788602b56b8.zh: 授权已不再有效 · 依据核查

62bc91ed76d4bf36.en: The attachment arrived at the same time and explains a specific issue. It is part of the training package and establishes the substance. The conditions for Article 11, part 4.1 are not met here, even if the first page alone is brief.
62bc91ed76d4bf36.zh: 附件同时送达并说明具体问题，属于教学材料的一部分，可以确定实质内容。即使第一页较简短，也未满足第11条第4.1款的适用条件。

43db39f43caa0d65.en: The answer is in the attachment · checking the basis
43db39f43caa0d65.zh: 答案在附件里 · 依据核查

53e2c7249c71e258.en: Article 11, part 5 ties this ground to appeals to the same body or official. The current body receives its first appeal on this subject; other bodies' letters do not replace that condition.
53e2c7249c71e258.zh: 第11条第5款将该依据限定于向同一机关或官员提出的申诉。当前机关首次收到其职责事项的申诉；其他机关的信函不能替代这一条件。

6a1a95d8af6e0469.en: There were replies, but from another body · checking the basis
6a1a95d8af6e0469.zh: 有过答复，但来自另一机关 · 依据核查

77c331c60d17072a.en: The training package contains only a registration notice, referral and interim status. There are no substantive replies. Article 11, part 5 does not permit counting outgoing letters instead of checking these conditions.
77c331c60d17072a.zh: 教学材料只有登记通知、转送和中间状态，没有实质答复。第11条第5款不允许以发文数量代替对这些条件的核查。

5802af6c2e76652c.en: Three letters, no substantive reply · checking the basis
5802af6c2e76652c.zh: 三封信，没有一封实质答复 · 依据核查

59474f51f9387103.en: An authorised person may end correspondence on an issue when all prescribed conditions are met. Check substantive replies, absence of new matters and the same recipient; notify the decision.
59474f51f9387103.zh: 全部规定条件具备时，获授权人员可以终止该事项通信。应核查实质答复、没有新内容及接收方相同，并通知决定。

d865f6225e604769.en: Law No. 59-ФЗ · conditions for ending correspondence
d865f6225e604769.zh: 第59-ФЗ号法律 · 终止通信条件

5873d5c136c21768.en: In this fictional situation, the substance cannot be determined after checking all text and the absence of attachments. Article 11, part 4.1 concerns that ground; part 4 concerns a different problem: illegible text.
5873d5c136c21768.zh: 本虚构情景中，核查全文并确认没有附件后仍无法确定实质内容。第11条第4.1款适用于该依据；第4款针对另一问题——文字无法辨认。

83183aeaf64862c2.en: Every word is legible, but the issue is unclear · checking the basis
83183aeaf64862c2.zh: 字都看得清，问题却不明确 · 依据核查

93206e72e85c5ddc.en: The surname and address are established, but the main text and any attachments do not allow the issue to be read. Article 11, part 4 requires notification when the surname and postal address are legible. Guessing a referral does not replace notification.
93206e72e85c5ddc.zh: 姓氏和地址已明确，但正文及可能的附件无法让人读出问题。第11条第4款规定，姓氏和邮寄地址可辨认时应告知这一情况。凭猜测转送不能替代通知。

b8af1a41bae167e6.en: The address is legible, the text is not · checking the basis
b8af1a41bae167e6.zh: 地址可辨，正文不可辨 · 依据核查

214fb7a053309d70.en: A free scheduled appointment was offered under the applicant's valid referral. The specialist's record confirms compliance with the applicable waiting period, a separate condition of this fictional case. The paid link appears first; the attachment provides the free compulsory-insurance route. Payment is not a condition of the free appointment. The applicant received the letter but did not open the attachment.
214fb7a053309d70.zh: 已根据申请人的有效转诊提供免费预约门诊。专业医生信息卡确认符合适用候诊期限，这是本虚构案件的独立条件。收费链接排在前面，附件中则有强制医疗保险项下免费途径。免费接诊不以付款为前提。申请人收到了信，却没有打开附件。

4b8691e8b45b2c23.en: A free appointment has already been offered · basis of the conclusion
4b8691e8b45b2c23.zh: 已经提供免费预约 · 结论依据

1059282c54e18cc9.en: The referral is valid. The scheduled care is included in the basic compulsory health insurance programme, and the organisation participates in the relevant field. These conditions are established for the training case, not for every clinic. Refusal is based solely on the valid policy being issued in another constituent entity. A paid appointment is offered instead of considering the referral. The message was received on the event date.
1059282c54e18cc9.zh: 转诊有效。该计划医疗服务纳入强制医疗保险基本项目，机构参与相应专业服务。这些条件仅为本教学案例设定，并非适用于所有诊所。拒绝的唯一理由是有效保单在另一个联邦主体签发。对方不审查转诊，却提供收费就诊。消息于事件日期收到。

c872a17ad621fc6f.en: The policy was issued elsewhere · basis of the conclusion
c872a17ad621fc6f.zh: 保单并非本地签发 · 结论依据

b92eea55f7aa2f50.en: The applicant reports a sudden current deterioration; the duty officer records that continuing an ordinary conversation is difficult. No clinical diagnosis is established, nor is diagnosis the student's task. Arrange contact with medical help and access for professionals; follow the medical dispatcher's instructions within your role. The training reporting button makes no actual emergency call. Do not demand payment or a policy before calling, and do not prescribe medicines.
b92eea55f7aa2f50.zh: 申请人报告当前状况突然恶化；值班员记录普通交谈已难以继续。尚未作出临床诊断，诊断也不是学生任务。应组织联系医疗援助并确保专业人员可接近，在角色权限内遵从医疗调度员指示。教学通报按钮不会实际呼叫急救。呼叫前不得要求付款或出示保单，也不得开药。

77900cb06c7dbb6c.en: The letter can wait; help is needed now · basis of the conclusion
77900cb06c7dbb6c.zh: 信函稍后处理，帮助现在就要 · 结论依据

f7c04a84351bd41c.en: The applicant requested a salary certificate for one period and a certified copy of their hiring order. A written application is confirmed. It concerns neither other employees nor their pay. A fee for 'certification services' was requested for these copies. The reply concerns that application and was received on the event date. Under the case conditions, the materials have not yet been issued.
f7c04a84351bd41c.zh: 申请人要求一个期间的工资证明和本人录用命令的认证副本。已确认提交书面申请，不涉及其他员工或其工资。提供这些副本却被要求支付“认证服务费”。答复对应该申请，于事件日期收到。按案情条件，材料尚未出具。

ada5f7a819ed929d.en: Pay for the copies first · basis of the conclusion
ada5f7a819ed929d.zh: 先为副本付费 · 结论依据

f4d7e958b1b719e1.en: One period is involved. Accrued: 60 000 roubles. Deducted on the stated payslip basis: 7 800 roubles. Payable: 52 200 roubles. The lawfulness of the deduction basis is outside this arithmetic exercise. The employee received 20 000 and 32 200 roubles. Payment references link both to the same payroll month. The case establishes that both arrived on time.
f4d7e958b1b719e1.zh: 涉及同一期间。应计60 000卢布；按工资单列明依据扣除7 800卢布；应付52 200卢布。扣款依据合法性不属于本算术练习事项。员工收到20 000和32 200卢布。付款用途说明将两笔款项关联至同一工资月份。案情已确定两笔均及时到账。

70b11c37d6f0d34b.en: One transfer and the whole payroll month · basis of the conclusion
70b11c37d6f0d34b.zh: 一笔转账与整月工资结算 · 结论依据

0847204b0cdda457.en: Accrued salary payable is 52 200 roubles. The employer acknowledged in writing a delay of ten calendar days. The supplied payslip has no late-payment compensation accrued. All information concerns one employee and period. A payment of 52 200 roubles arrived, described as salary for the same period. The supplied statement segment contains no other receipts, including compensation. The last payment and employer's letter arrived on the event date.
0847204b0cdda457.zh: 应付工资为52 200卢布。雇主书面承认延迟十个日历日。所提供工资单没有计提迟延付款补偿。全部信息涉及同一员工和期间。已到账52 200卢布，用途为该期间工资。所提供账单片段中没有其他入账，包括补偿。最后一笔付款及雇主信函均于事件日期收到。

c08b9f55f614b036.en: The training task for Т-12 includes pipeline replacement, resurfacing and removal of materials. The temporary bypass was checked and remains safe. The deadline for each stage follows the contractor's confirmed schedule. Testing of the new pipeline was accepted. The report does not include pavement restoration or material removal. The contractor's message on the event date wrongly describes the entire project as complete.
c08b9f55f614b036.zh: Т-12教学任务包括更换管道、恢复路面和清运材料。临时绕行路线已经核查，仍然安全。各阶段期限依据承办方确认的进度表确定。新管道试验已验收，但报告不包含人行道恢复和材料清运。承办方在事件日期的消息错误地称整个工程已完成。

933d01e1a065deda.en: Pipe replaced, pavement not restored · basis of the conclusion
933d01e1a065deda.zh: 管道换了，人行道未恢复 · 结论依据
